title: Prompt functions are module attributes swapped by CliRunner for tests
answers: How do tests feed input to prompts?
body: `termui.visible_prompt_func` (=input) and `termui.hidden_prompt_func` (getpass) are module-level so they can be replaced. `testing.py` `CliRunner.isolation` saves and replaces both with `visible_input`/`hidden_input` reading simulated stdin, then restores them. `prompt()` must look them up at call time (`f = hidden_prompt_func if hide_input else visible_prompt_func`) — don't bind them earlier or import by name, or the test override breaks.
